summary.headline: Most open deals carry one activity or none — an AI would be blind on half the pipeline.
summary.narrative: Logged coverage averages under one activity per open opportunity, and several open deals have no activity at all. Even the well-documented Northwind call's qualification detail isn't structured on the record. Improve auto-capture and set a per-stage minimum before an AI summarises deals.

findings.title: Eight open deals have no logged activity
findings.what_we_found: Open opportunities OPP-2004, OPP-2008, OPP-2009, OPP-2011, OPP-2014, OPP-2017 and OPP-2020 have no rows in the activity log; OPP-2006 (Proposal, $54K) also has none.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: An AI knows nothing about these deals beyond static fields — no calls, no emails, no context to summarise or act on. They are effectively invisible to any assistant.
the_fix: Turn on automatic call/meeting/email capture for all reps.
Backfill these specific open deals from calendars and inboxes.
Surface zero-activity open deals to managers as a weekly hygiene list.
findings.evidence: These opp_ids appear in opportunities.csv but never in activities.csv.

findings.title: Six-figure deals running on a single activity
findings.what_we_found: OPP-2003 (Initech renewal, $120K) and OPP-2010 (Tyrell, $99K) each have just one logged activity despite being in Negotiation.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: Coverage this thin gives an AI almost nothing to reason over on the highest-value deals, exactly where reliable summarisation matters most.
the_fix: Set a minimum logged-activity expectation per stage (deeper for late stages).
Prompt owners to log the recent touches on these key deals.
Re-check coverage on deals above a value threshold before any AI summary.
findings.evidence: Single activity rows ACT-3004 and ACT-3008 for $120K and $99K Negotiation deals.

findings.title: Qualification detail from the Northwind call isn't structured on the record
findings.what_we_found: The Northwind transcript (OPP-2001) captures budget, economic buyer, and a compelling event, and the call is logged (ACT-3001) — but that rich detail lives only in the transcript text, not in structured fields.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: An AI would have to re-parse free text every time; the qualification signals aren't durably captured where they can be scored or reused.
the_fix: Land transcript summaries on the opportunity and map key signals to fields.
Use the Transcript to Deal Update activation tool to draft the structured update for the rep to paste.
findings.evidence: call-transcript.txt contains budget/EB/timeline; activity ACT-3001 logs the call but not the detail.
